title: Stress memory channel probes 6 of 54 scenarios: a 2x retained-bytes regression in any of the other 48 passes
claim: With a ballast equal to each scenario's recorded traced peak retained inside HeatPumpOptimizer.optimize (a 2x traced regression), the gate's own thresholds flag 54/54 probe readings, but the memory pass only probes the 6 labels _memory_probe_labels selects, so a 2x confined to any of the other 48 scenarios passes green, while the pass's detection check ('budgets tight enough to see a 2x') reports green on multiples computed over all recorded rows.
mechanism: tests/stress.py's memory pass (check mode) probes MEMORY_TOP_N=6 labels chosen from the committed table (3 by traced_peak_mb, 3 by rss_peak_mb); the other rows of stress_budgets.json are never measured in a gate run. The detection-sizing check computes rss/traced threshold multiples (1.5x) over every recorded row and prints them 'over the 6 scenario(s) this pass probes', so it holds the thresholds to DETECTION_TARGET but never the sampling. Corollary from the null arm: on this box's clean tree 9 of the 48 unprobed rows already read 1.6-2.3x their record (their records are never re-read), so the table's unprobed half is unverified.

evidence.unit: scenarios where an injected 2x traced regression is flagged by the gate's thresholds but never probed (blind_confined); detected_confined=6 of 54
evidence.machine: cloud box B3, Linux x86_64 4 vCPU shared by up to 3 compute seats, Python 3.14.7, numpy 2.5.4
evidence.contention_note: two other compute seats on the box, load1 11.3; the count is of bytes-based verdicts and does not depend on timing
evidence.tolerance: exact (probe set is a pure function of the committed table)

instrumented_symbol: heatpump_optimizer.optimizer:HeatPumpOptimizer.optimize (ballast retained there, read through stress._run_memory_probe / traced_fail_threshold / rss_attrib_fail_threshold and the gate's _memory_probe_labels exec'd from tests/stress.py)

perturbation.change: --top-n 108 (the gate's STRESS_MEMORY_TOP_N raised past the scenario count, so the pass probes every scenario)

metric_definition: Per sweep scenario: detected = in the gate's memory probe set AND the gate's own traced/RSS thresholds fire on the probe reading with a retained ballast of 1x the recorded traced peak.
phenomenon_property: Every scenario whose memory peak is recorded in tests/stress_budgets.json must be re-measured by a gate run (or the detection check must count only the rows it re-measures), so that a 2x memory regression confined to any recorded scenario fails the gate.
seam_rule: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D9/s3/mem_confined.py --ballast-factor 1.0  (BLIND line lists every recorded scenario the pass does not probe)

null_control.note: No injection: the 6 probed scenarios read inside 1.5x (no false positive); the injection is what moves the probed set to flagged. 9 unprobed rows read 1.6-2.3x their record clean on this box, so 39 of the 48 blind scenarios are blind to the injection alone.

reproduction_steps: Run the harness with default args: RESULT detected_confined=6, blind_confined=48.
Run with --top-n 108: detected_confined rises to the scenarios flagged.
proposed_fix_scope: tests/stress.py memory pass: probe every recorded scenario in check mode (or rotate a deterministic subset with a per-run budget and make the detection check judge only the probed rows); re-record the memory half on the CI platform after.
